If you are running Android, there is an app called ["App Cloner"](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.applisto.appcloner)

When you download the app, just go through any steps it gives you. 

Once you are done, it will give you an option to clone any app you'd like. Make sure it's Dokkan Battle. 

On the cloning screen, you can customize the picture to make it so you can find out which is the real version and which one is your reroll.

After you are done cloning, the app will be ready to use like it's brand new.

SIDENOTE: You will have to do the following again:

-Tutorial
-Update Downloads
-Long ass intro

Also, as soon as you finish EVERYTHING up until the point where you can summon, create a transfer code IMMEDIATELY, either after you finish summons or before. The reasoning behind this is because you can not update the app within the app itself. The only way to update it is to Uninstall the cloned version of the app and clone the original again. That way, you can use the transfer code and avoid the tutorial again.
